title: [CI] Restore allocator settings in test_cuda.py to fix expandable_segments leak
body:
test_garbage_collect_expandable left expandable_segments:True in the runtime allocator config. AcceleratorAllocatorConfig::parseArgs only auto-resets a few tuning knobs (max_split_size, roundup_power2_divisions, garbage_collection_threshold), so later _set_allocator_settings calls without an explicit expandable_segments key did not undo the leak. Once #180263 disabled test_max_split_expandable, which had been resetting the value, the leak reached test_allocate_in_thread_to_pool and made #158764 flaky.

Save and restore allocator settings around the two expandable-mode tests, and pin state in TestBlockStateAbsorption.setUp/tearDown so future leaks can't reopen this.

Fixes #158764
Fixes #180263

Authored with Claude.
